entries.clue: Light-blue line from Brixton up to Walthamstow, named for a queen
The network has 272 of them, some buried deep, some out in open country
Dinah's kind, the creature Alice drowsily pairs with bats down the hole
The howling baby grunts and turns into one as Alice carries it outdoors
Slender spire of rock on a mountainside, or the high point of a career
Insect the size of a chicken that names the rocking-horse-fly for Alice
Seasoning the cook adds so freely that the baby sneezes without pause
Court Road stop on the edge of Soho, rebuilt and enlarged for the Elizabeth line
Rough overnight stop with no tent to speak of
Stacked stones marking a route in poor visibility
River of ice grinding slowly downhill
Fare ring — the middle of London is number one
